card.name: Time cutoffs in colonoscopy prep
card.fires_on: Small words or symbols right before a number of hours in bowel-prep fasting instructions, such as "up to", "within" or "at least" before "2 hours".

modes.label: Linking word before hours
modes.description: The word "to" after "clear liquids up" just before a time limit.
modes.example: On the day of the colonoscopy only consume clear liquids up<< to>> two hours prior to colonoscopy.

modes.label: Opening bracket or space before a time
modes.description: A parenthesis or space just before a number of hours in dosing-day steps.
modes.example: Do not consume solid food within<< >>2 hours before starting PEG-3

card.writes: The promoted tokens relate to sealing, which has no clear link to the text, so there is no clear output effect.
